import polars as pl


def transform(raw: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return raw.select(
        device_id=pl.col("Device").str.to_uppercase(),
        read_at=pl.col("Time").str.to_datetime(
            format="%d/%m/%Y %H:%M", strict=False
        ),
        temperature_c=pl.col("Temperature")
        .str.replace("°C", "", literal=True)
        .cast(pl.Float64, strict=False),
        humidity_pct=pl.col("Humidity")
        .str.replace("%", "", literal=True)
        .cast(pl.Float64, strict=False),
        battery_v=pl.col("Battery")
        .str.replace("V", "", literal=True)
        .cast(pl.Float64, strict=False),
    )
